en: A multi-image postcard showing three landscape scenes. The upper-left image depicts a river with lush green vegetation in the foreground and a city skyline behind it, including a tall church tower and an arched bridge crossing the river. The upper-right image shows a wintery riverside meadow with patches of snow, leafless trees, and a herd of grazing horses. The bottom image captures a rural dike road at dusk with a cyclist riding along it, silhouettes of people cut-out figures near the roadside, and wide flat fields under a dramatic dark-blue sky. At the bottom right, partially visible text reads "NIJMEGEN EN OOIJPOLDER".
